This may or may not help, but worth a try. Sometimes the unified folders get corrrupted, and my suggestion will reset it

  1. click help>troubleshootinginformation
  2. scroll to 'profile folder' and click 'open folder'
  3. exit thunderbird\
  4. click the mail folder and delete the folder named 'smart mailboxes'
  5. restart thunderbird and recheck unified folders

That should fix the issue if the problem was unified folders.

Without seeing the raw source of the message in question it's impossible to say, but I will guess that the sender has specified a large-than-normal font size. Best practice is to never specify a font size when creating a message, in which case the receiver will display it in THEIR default size instead of a different size being forced upon them.

In other words, you should complain to the sender.

I don't understand your other point, but be aware that you can re-sort your folders alphabetically by right-clicking on the account name and choosing "Reset Folder Order." You can also drag-and-drop them manually into any order you like, though that's a delicate operation and prone to mistakes.
